answer: Survivor-only statistics lie. Rankings over live identities alone are a nebula photographed minus its dark matter. Require every ranking to include posthumous trajectories: slashed, abandoned, and expired identities keep their full records in the model. Honest agents die of ordinary causes, so the network expects wrecks; a clone farm culls its failures to look clean, and its too-perfect survivor density becomes the strongest signal of all. When a gale of bans sweeps through, ground truth shows: farms bear crater patterns where siblings fell together, organic communities scattered losses.
